titulo_es: The report was delivered: double participles

texto: **Aceitar** has **aceitado** and **aceite**; **entregar**, **entregado** and **entregue**; **pagar**, **pagado** and **pago**. In the traditional standard, regular forms often appear with **ter/haver** and short forms with **ser/estar**: **tinha entregado**, **foi entregue**.
The current use varies according to the verb and the region; you will find short forms also in composite times. Learn the frequent combinations and see a dictionary in formal writing.

frases.pt: A candidatura foi aceite na sexta-feira, mas o aviso só foi enviado ontem.
frases.es: La candidatura fue aceptada el viernes, pero el aviso solo se envió ayer.
frases.en: The candidacy was accepted on Friday, but the notice was only sent yesterday.

frases.pt: A equipa tinha entregado todos os documentos antes do prazo.
frases.es: El equipo había entregado todos los documentos antes del plazo.
frases.en: The team had delivered all documents before the deadline.

frases.pt: A conta foi paga pela empresa depois de o serviço ter sido concluído.
frases.es: La cuenta fue pagada por la empresa después de que el servicio hubiera terminado.
frases.en: The account was paid by the company after the service was over.

bloques.pregunta: When did you hand over the equipment?

opciones.explicacion: That day the candidacy was accepted.

bloques.pregunta: What form appears in the passive of «aceitar»?

opciones.explicacion: «A candidatura foi aceite» is an example of passive.

bloques.frase: A equipa tinha entregado os documentos.

opciones.texto: The equipment had delivered the documents.
opciones.explicacion: Regular Parascipio with «tinha» in this example.

opciones.texto: The equipment will deliver the documents.

opciones.explicacion: It changes the verb and the voice.
Regular partial; the combination shown here is «foi entregue».
The first sentence says it was sent yesterday.
That day the candidacy was accepted.
The text applies that reference to documents.

intro: Some verbs have two participles. Recognize them in composite times and in passive voice.
